description:
Apple Vision Pro brought spatial computing to the world, and we're just getting started. The System UI team builds the experiences and system behaviors at the heart of visionOS, defining how people use vision products such as Apple Vision Pro every day.

We're looking for an engineer who is eager to learn and grow: someone who loves building interfaces that feel effortless, thrives on fast iteration with interface designers, and wants to help shape what spatial computing becomes next, from intelligent, context-aware system experiences to interactions that flow seamlessly across Apple devices.

Description
As a system UI engineer, you'll build the applications and system behaviors that define the overall experience of our platform, ultimately shaping the way customers use our products. You'll take work from early concept through shipping software, iterating rapidly alongside designers to get every interaction, animation, and detail right.

You'll work with technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, RealityKit, and ARKit, along with a wide range of internal frameworks and services that let you build experiences deeply integrated into the operating system. We build with modern tools, including AI and agentic development tools, to move quickly from idea to polished experience without compromising on quality.

Responsibilities
Design, build, and own system experiences on Apple’s vision products end-to-end, from early concept through shipping
Iterate rapidly with designers, refining interactions, motion, and detail through tight feedback loops
Build and evolve the architecture and frameworks that system experiences are built on
Profile and tune frame-rate, latency, power, and thermals so experiences feel fast and fluid
Build intelligent, context-aware system experiences powered by Apple Intelligence and on-device machine learning
Create experiences that work seamlessly across Apple Vision Pro and other Apple devices
Partner closely with UI frameworks, app, hardware and product, Apple Intelligence, and other platforms' system UI teams

Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
0-3 years of professional software development experience
Experience with Swift through internships, projects, or professional work
Experience building UI with SwiftUI or UIKit
Comfortable and eager to use AI and agentic development tools in your daily work, with the judgment to review, test, and own the code they help produce
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Attention to detail, creativity, and passion for craft

Preferred qualifications
Experience with RealityKit, ARKit, or other 3D and spatial frameworks
Experience with Swift concurrency, including async/await, actors, and Swift 6 strict concurrency
Proficiency in Objective-C or C++
